13	/-!
14	# The base-field window transport pack — DDR-2's `N`-pack (DAT-D `dd4`/`ddr`)
15	
16	The abstract fibre window divisor `N` of DDR-2's certified-degree pinch
17	(`RiemannRoch/CarveDegree.lean`), built for any field extension `K/k`: an honest Weil
18	divisor on `relCurve C K` carrying the **transported** DD-0 window facts of the `k`-level
19	embedding window `M·F`.  Per I-0204's binding architectural finding, the per-field ledger
20	constants do *not* transport (`windowM_choice` is a per-field `Classical.choose`), so `N`
21	is produced by transporting window **facts**, not by re-running the `K`-level ledger:
22	
23	* the `k`-level `H¹` inputs enter through the landed twist-pair collapse
24	  (`relThetaPairH1_windowM`, `subsingleton_relThetaPairH1`) and cross into the datum
25	  world by the whole-chart theta datum (`Cohomology/RelCurveCollapse.lean`);
26	* the datum base-changes to `K` (`datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange`), where the
27	  presentation bridge (`presentationSheafIso` + `subsingleton_hModule_gluedSheaf_one_iff`)
28	  extracts an honest divisor `windowTransportDivisor C K π a` with vanishing `H¹`;
29	* its class is the transported theta class (`cechPicClass_baseChange` + the collapse
30	  class law), so its degree is `a·δ` by E-iv-alg
31	  (`classDeg_cechPicMap_baseFieldTransition`) and W7-B3 (`classDeg_cechPicMap_of_isIso`);
32	* the `K`-level normalization windows come from the π-free peeling
33	  (`subsingleton_hModule_one_of_witness`, the abstract-witness form of DAT-0a's
34	  `exists_bound_subsingleton_hModule_one_of_isFinite_toP1`) at the transported
35	  multiplier window `s·F`, licensed by ledger arithmetic.
36	
37	## The `N`-pack (DDR-2's threaded hypotheses, exact spellings)
38	
39	At `N := windowN C K π hπ g = windowTransportDivisor C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g)`:
40	
41	* `hNwin` — `subsingleton_h1_windowN` : `Subsingleton H¹(𝒪(N))`;
42	* `hNdeg` — `two_mul_genus_le_deg_windowN` : `2g ≤ deg K N`;
43	* `hNnorm` — `subsingleton_h1_windowN_sub` : `∀ D', deg D' ≤ 2g → Subsingleton
44	  H¹(𝒪(N − D'))`;
45	* `hNrank` — `h0_windowN` : `h⁰_K(𝒪(N)) = h⁰_k(𝒪(M·F))`.
46	
47	The remaining threaded hypothesis of `deg_divFamDivisor_of_carve` supplied elsewhere is
48	`hdict` (the sections dictionary at the field point, DD-4 Task 5 field content — still
49	open), besides the sibling seams `hsurj`/`hpair`.
50	-/

68	/-! ## The π-free peeling: uniform `H¹`-vanishing from an abstract witness -/
69	
70	section Peeling
71	
72	variable (K : Type u) [Field K] {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Y]
73	  [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
74	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
75	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
76	  [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
77	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 0)]
78	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 1)]
79	
80	omit [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] in
81	/-- **The π-free peeling** (the abstract-witness form of DAT-0a): a single witness
82	divisor `W₀` with vanishing `H¹` makes `H¹(𝒪(D))` vanish for **every** divisor `D` of
83	degree `≥ deg W₀ + 1 − χ(𝒪_Y)` — the residual class `[D]·[W₀]⁻¹` has an effective
84	representative (`exists_effective_of_picClass`), peeling (`peel_effective`) transports
85	the vanishing to `W₀ + E`, and witness-independence
86	(`subsingleton_hModule_one_of_picClass_eq`) reaches `D`. -/
87	theorem subsingleton_hModule_one_of_witness (W₀ D : Y.CurveDivisor)
88	    (hW₀ : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K W₀) 1))
89	    (hdeg : CurveDivisor.deg K W₀ + 1 - Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K)
90	      ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K D) :
91	    Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K D) 1) := by
92	  set c : Y.CechPic :=
93	    CurveDivisor.picClass K D * (CurveDivisor.picClass K W₀)⁻¹ with hc
94	  obtain ⟨Wc, hWc⟩ := CurveDivisor.exists_picClass_eq K c
95	  have hWcdeg : CurveDivisor.deg K Wc
96	      = CurveDivisor.deg K D - CurveDivisor.deg K W₀ := by
97	    rw [← classDeg_picClass K Wc, hWc, hc, classDeg_mul, classDeg_inv,
98	      classDeg_picClass, classDeg_picClass]
99	    ring
100	  have hWdeg : 1 ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K Wc + Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) := by
101	    rw [hWcdeg]; linarith
102	  obtain ⟨E, hE0, hEc⟩ := exists_effective_of_picClass Wc hWdeg
103	  have hclass : CurveDivisor.picClass K (W₀ + E) = CurveDivisor.picClass K D := by
104	    rw [CurveDivisor.picClass_add, hEc, hWc, hc,
105	      mul_comm (CurveDivisor.picClass K D), ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, one_mul]
106	  exact subsingleton_hModule_one_of_picClass_eq K hclass
107	    (peel_effective W₀ E hE0 hW₀)
108	
109	end Peeling

111	/-! ## The transported window divisor at a field extension -/
112	
113	section Transport
114	
115	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
116	variable (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K]
117	variable (π : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite π]
118	variable [IsIntegral (relCurve C K)]
119	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
120	  [QuasiCompact (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
121	variable (a : ℕ)
122	
123	/-- **The transported theta datum**: the whole-chart theta datum of the base field,
124	base-changed to `K`. -/
125	noncomputable def windowTransportDatum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C K π :=
126	  (thetaChartDatum C k π a).baseChange K
127	
128	/-- **The `K`-fibre presentation of the transported theta class**: the meromorphic
129	presentation of the subordinated cocycle of the transported datum on its canonical
130	pointed cover (the target of `presentationSheafIso`). -/
131	noncomputable def windowTransportPresentation : (relCurve C K).MeromorphicPresentation :=
132	  Scheme.MeromorphicPresentation.ofCocycle (windowTransportDatum C K π a).pointedCover
133	    (gluedSubordCocycle (windowTransportDatum C K π a).isGluingCocycle
134	      (windowTransportDatum C K π a).pointedCover
135	      (windowTransportDatum C K π a).pieceIndex fun _ => le_rfl)
136	
137	/-- **The transported window divisor** `N(a)` on the `K`-fibre: the presentation divisor
138	of the transported theta presentation — an honest Weil divisor in the transported class
139	`Θᵃ`. -/
140	noncomputable def windowTransportDivisor : (relCurve C K).CurveDivisor :=
141	  Scheme.presentationDivisor K (windowTransportPresentation C K π a)
142	
143	/-- **`H¹` of the transported window divisor vanishes** whenever the `k`-level theta
144	pair `H¹` does (the ledger input, e.g. `relThetaPairH1_windowM`): the `H¹` seam of the
145	collapse brick pushed through the datum base change and the presentation bridge. -/
146	theorem subsingleton_h1_windowTransportDivisor
147	    (h : Subsingleton (relTwistPair C k π (relThetaCocycle C k π a)).H1) :
148	    Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
149	      ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K (windowTransportDivisor C K π a)) 1) := by
150	  have h1 : Subsingleton (datumPair (thetaChartDatum C k π a)).H1 :=
151	    subsingleton_datumPair_h1_thetaChartDatum C π a h
152	  have h2 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (windowTransportDatum C K π a).sheaf 1) :=
153	    BasicOpenCocycleDatum.datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange K (thetaChartDatum C k π a) h1
154	  have h3 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
155	      ((windowTransportPresentation C K π a).gluedSheaf K) 1) :=
156	    (Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv
157	      (BasicOpenCocycleDatum.presentationSheafIso (windowTransportDatum C K π a))
158	      1).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mp h2
159	  exact (subsingleton_hModule_gluedSheaf_one_iff K _).mp h3
160	
161	/-- The transported window divisor lies in the transported datum class. -/
162	theorem picClass_windowTransportDivisor :
163	    CurveDivisor.picClass K (windowTransportDivisor C K π a)
164	      = (windowTransportDatum C K π a).cechPicClass := by
165	  rw [windowTransportDivisor, CurveDivisor.picClass_presentationDivisor]
166	  rfl
167	
168	end Transport

171	
172	section Degree
173	
174	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
175	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
176	variable (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K]
177	variable (π : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite π] [IsDominant π]
178	variable [IsIntegral C.left]
179	
180	noncomputable local instance instOverCleftDeg : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
181	
182	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
183	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
184	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
185	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
186	variable [IsIntegral (relCurve C K)]
187	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
188	  [QuasiCompact (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
189	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
190	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) 0)]
191	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) 1)]
192	variable (a : ℕ)
193	
194	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
195	/-- The relative-curve comparison at the base-field transition `k → K` is the E-iv-alg
196	transition morphism. -/
197	lemma relCurveMap_eq_overSpecMap_ofId :
198	    relCurveMap C k K = (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (Algebra.ofId k K)).left := by
199	  refine congrArg (fun φ : C ⊗ overSpec k K ⟶ C ⊗ overSpec k k => φ.left)
200	    (congrArg (fun ψ : overSpec k K ⟶ overSpec k k => C ◁ ψ) ?_)
201	  exact Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl
202	
203	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
204	/-- The structure morphism of the self test `overSpec k k` is the identity. -/
205	lemma overSpec_self_hom : (overSpec k k).hom = 𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := by
206	  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)) = _
207	  rw [Algebra.algebraMap_self, CommRingCat.ofHom_id, Spec.map_id]
208	
209	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
210	/-- The base-field collapse is a morphism of curve bundles over `Spec k`: composing with
211	the structure morphism of `C.left` gives the structure morphism of the relative curve. -/
212	lemma fst_left_self_over :
213	    letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
214	    (fst C (overSpec k k)).left ≫ (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
215	      = relCurve C k ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) := by
216	  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
217	  change (fst C (overSpec k k)).left ≫ C.hom = (snd C (overSpec k k)).left
218	  rw [Over.w (fst C (overSpec k k)), ← Over.w (snd C (overSpec k k)),
219	    overSpec_self_hom (k := k)]
220	  exact Category.comp_id _
221	
222	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 8 in
223	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000 in
224	-- (The two-field instance towers of the degree stack at `k` and `K` exceed the default
225	-- synthesis limits; the I-0198 escape hatch.)
226	/-- **The degree of the transported window divisor is `a·δ`**: E-i reads the degree off
227	the class, `cechPicClass_baseChange` and E-iv-alg carry it to the base field, the
228	collapse class law identifies it with the pulled fiber twist, and W7-B3 computes it as
229	`a · classDeg (Θ¹) = a · δ`. -/
230	theorem deg_windowTransportDivisor :
231	    CurveDivisor.deg K (windowTransportDivisor C K π a) = (a : ℤ) * windowδ π := by
232	  haveI : IsIntegral (relCurve C k) := instIsIntegralBaseChange C k
233	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C k ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
234	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C k
235	  haveI : QuasiCompact (relCurve C k ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
236	    instQuasiCompactBaseChange C k
237	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C k).moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
238	    instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C k
239	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C k).moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
240	    instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C k
241	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
242	      ((C ⊗ overSpec k k).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
243	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C k
244	  haveI : QuasiCompact ((C ⊗ overSpec k k).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
245	    instQuasiCompactBaseChange C k
246	  have hbc : (windowTransportDatum C K π a).cechPicClass
247	      = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k K)
248	          (thetaChartDatum C k π a).cechPicClass :=
249	    BasicOpenCocycleDatum.cechPicClass_baseChange K (thetaChartDatum C k π a)
250	  -- E-iv-alg at the transition `k → K`, bridged across the `relCurveMap` spelling
251	  have htr : classDeg K (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k K)
252	        (thetaChartDatum C k π a).cechPicClass)
253	      = classDeg k (thetaChartDatum C k π a).cechPicClass := by
254	    rw [relCurveMap_eq_overSpecMap_ofId C K]
255	    exact classDeg_cechPicMap_baseFieldTransition C (Algebra.ofId k K) _
256	  -- the collapse class law and W7-B3 at the base field
257	  have hcol : classDeg k (Scheme.CechPic.map (fst C (overSpec k k)).left
258	        (fiberTwist π a))
259	      = (a : ℤ) * windowδ π := by
260	    have h := classDeg_cechPicMap_of_isIso k (fst C (overSpec k k)).left
261	      (fst_left_self_over C) (fiberTwist π a)
262	    rw [h, fiberTwist_pow, classDeg_pow]
263	    rfl
264	  rw [← classDeg_picClass K (windowTransportDivisor C K π a),
265	    picClass_windowTransportDivisor, hbc, htr, cechPicClass_thetaChartDatum C π a]
266	  exact hcol
267	
268	end Degree

283	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
284	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
285	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]

288	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
289	  [QuasiCompact (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
290	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
291	variable [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) 0)]

294	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
295	/-- **The `H¹` input at the multiplier window `s`** (`window_embedding_mult`, DAT-0a),
296	transported onto the relative theta pair — the `s`-companion of
297	`relThetaPairH1_windowM`. -/
298	theorem relThetaPairH1_windowS (g : ℕ) :
299	    Subsingleton
300	      (relTwistPair C k π (relThetaCocycle C k π (windowS_choice π hπ g))).H1 :=
301	  subsingleton_relThetaPairH1 C π _
302	    ((subsingleton_hModule_thetaTwistSheaf_one_iff k π _).mpr
303	      (window_embedding_mult π hπ g))

306	divisor at the `k`-ledger embedding exponent `M = windowM_choice π hπ g`. -/
307	noncomputable def windowN (g : ℕ) : (relCurve C K).CurveDivisor :=
308	  windowTransportDivisor C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g)

311	/-- **`hNwin`**: `H¹(𝒪(N)) = 0` — the transported embedding window
312	(`window_embedding` at `k`, pushed across the collapse and the base change). -/
313	theorem subsingleton_h1_windowN (g : ℕ) :
314	    Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
315	      ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K (windowN C K hπ g)) 1) :=

341	          (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)) := by
342	  have hK : (Sheaf.h0 ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K (windowN C K hπ g)) : ℤ)
343	      = CurveDivisor.deg K (windowN C K hπ g)
344	        + Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) :=
345	    h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one _ (subsingleton_h1_windowN C K hπ g)

347	        (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)) : ℤ)
348	      = (windowM_choice π hπ g : ℤ) * windowδ π + 1 - (g : ℤ) :=

351	  have hcast : (Sheaf.h0 ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K (windowN C K hπ g)) : ℤ)
352	      = (Sheaf.h0 (C.left.divisorSheaf k
353	          (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)) : ℤ) := by
354	    rw [hK, hdeg, hχK, hk]
355	    ring
356	  exact_mod_cast hcast

358	/-- **`hNnorm`**: the transported normalization windows — for every `K`-divisor `D'` of
359	degree `≤ 2g`, `H¹(𝒪(N − D')) = 0`.  The π-free peeling at the transported multiplier
360	window `s·F` (or at `N` itself in the degenerate `windowBound ≤ 0` branch, where
361	`g = 0`), licensed by the ledger budgets. -/
362	theorem subsingleton_h1_windowN_sub (g : ℕ)
363	    (hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1)
364	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
365	    (hχK : Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
366	    (D' : (relCurve C K).CurveDivisor)
367	    (hD' : CurveDivisor.deg K D' ≤ 2 * (g : ℤ)) :
368	    Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
369	      ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K (windowN C K hπ g - D')) 1) := by
370	  have hsub : CurveDivisor.deg K (windowN C K hπ g - D')
371	      = CurveDivisor.deg K (windowN C K hπ g) - CurveDivisor.deg K D' := by
372	    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, CurveDivisor.deg_add, CurveDivisor.deg_neg, sub_eq_add_neg]

374	  · -- degenerate branch: `g = 0`, peel from `N` itself
375	    have hg0 : g = 0 := genus_eq_zero_of_windowBound_nonpos π hπ g hb hO hχ
376	    refine subsingleton_hModule_one_of_witness K (windowN C K hπ g) _
377	      (subsingleton_h1_windowN C K hπ g) ?_

382	    refine subsingleton_hModule_one_of_witness K
383	      (windowTransportDivisor C K π (windowS_choice π hπ g)) _
384	      (subsingleton_h1_windowTransportDivisor C K π _ (relThetaPairH1_windowS C hπ g))
385	      ?_

387	    have hb1 : 0 < windowBound π hπ := not_le.mp hb
388	    have hM := windowM_spec π hπ g
389	    have hδ := one_le_windowδ π
390	    have hs : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (windowS_choice π hπ g : ℤ) := Int.natCast_nonneg _
391	    have hg : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (g : ℤ) := Int.natCast_nonneg _
392	    have hkey : (windowS_choice π hπ g : ℤ) * windowδ π + ((g : ℤ) + 2)
393	        ≤ ((g : ℤ) + 2) * ((windowS_choice π hπ g : ℤ) + 1) * windowδ π := by
394	      nlinarith [hs, hg, hδ, mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℤ) ≤ (g:ℤ) + 1) hs)

9	/-!
10	# Base-change instances for the curve over an extension field (gap G-D5(a))
11	
12	For the challenge curve `C : Over (Spec k)` (smooth of relative dimension one, proper and
13	geometrically irreducible over the field `k`) and a field extension `K` of `k`
14	(`[Field K] [Algebra k K]`), this file installs — **as instances that fire by typeclass
15	resolution** — every hypothesis of the landed degree/Riemann–Roch stack
16	(`AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Degree`) for the base-changed curve
17	
18	`C_K := (C ⊗ overSpec k K).left`,
19	
20	viewed as a `K`-scheme via the **second projection** `(snd C (overSpec k K)).left`. This is
21	exactly the `Over`-instance spelling that `Cohomology.RelativeTwoCover.relCurve.instOver`
22	uses (`.ofHom (snd C (overSpec k K)).left`), but keyed on the `(C ⊗ overSpec k K).left`
23	spelling that the Riemann–Roch files consume, rather than on the `relCurve C K` `def`.
24	
25	The single geometric input is the pullback bridge `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isPullback_left`
26	(`Cohomology.SectionsBaseChange`): the second projection `(snd C (overSpec k K)).left` is the
27	base change of the structure morphism `C.hom` along `overSpec k K ⟶ Spec k`. Every morphism
28	property then transports by `MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange` (smooth of relative
29	dimension one, proper, geometrically irreducible), and integrality of `C_K` is
30	`isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced` applied to the base change (geometric
31	irreducibility is transported; geometric reducedness comes for free from smoothness).
32	
33	## Main instances (keyed for the Riemann–Roch stack)
34	
35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.instOverBaseChange` — item 1: `(C ⊗ overSpec k K).left` is a `K`-scheme
36	  via the second projection; `(C ⊗ overSpec k K).left ↘ Spec K = (snd C (overSpec k K)).left`
37	  definitionally (`baseChange_over_eq_snd_left`).
38	* `AlgebraicGeometry.instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionSndLeft`,
39	  `AlgebraicGeometry.instIsProperSndLeft`,
40	  `AlgebraicGeometry.instGeometricallyIrreducibleSndLeft` — the base-change transport of the
41	  standing bundle onto the raw morphism `(snd C (overSpec k K)).left`.
42	* `AlgebraicGeometry.instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange` (item 2),
43	  `AlgebraicGeometry.instIsProperBaseChange`,
44	  `AlgebraicGeometry.instQuasiCompactBaseChange` (item 4) — the same properties in the
45	  `↘`-spelling `(C ⊗ overSpec k K).left ↘ Spec K` that `classDeg` queries.
46	* `AlgebraicGeometry.instIsIntegralBaseChange` (item 3): `C_K` is integral.
47	* `AlgebraicGeometry.instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange`,
48	  `AlgebraicGeometry.instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange` (item 5): the two structure-sheaf
49	  cohomology finiteness instances over `K`.
50	
51	The acceptance smoke test (item 6) verifies that the landed `classDeg K` typechecks on `C_K`
52	with every hypothesis inferred by resolution.
53	-/

68	
69	/-- **Item 1.** The base-changed curve `C_K := (C ⊗ overSpec k K).left` is a scheme over

71	structure morphism that `Cohomology.RelativeTwoCover.relCurve.instOver` installs, but keyed on

88	
89	Every property is transported from `C.hom` along the base-change square

91	keyed on the raw morphism `(snd C (overSpec k K)).left`, which is what the bundled curve

93	(`isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced`, `moduleFinite_hModule_zero`/`_one`). -/

95	/-- **Base change of smooth-of-relative-dimension-one.** The second projection is smooth of
96	relative dimension one over `K`, by `smoothOfRelativeDimension_isStableUnderBaseChange`. -/

98	    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (snd C (overSpec k K)).left :=

100	    smoothOfRelativeDimension_isStableUnderBaseChange 1
101	  MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1)
102	    (Over.isPullback_left C (overSpec k K)) inferInstance
103	
104	/-- **Base change of properness.** The second projection is proper over `K`
105	(`IsProper.isStableUnderBaseChange`). -/
106	instance instIsProperSndLeft : IsProper (snd C (overSpec k K)).left :=
107	  MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @IsProper)
108	    (Over.isPullback_left C (overSpec k K)) inferInstance
109	
110	/-- **Base change of geometric irreducibility.** The second projection is geometrically
111	irreducible over `K` (`GeometricallyIrreducible` is stable under base change). -/
112	instance instGeometricallyIrreducibleSndLeft :
113	    GeometricallyIrreducible (snd C (overSpec k K)).left :=
114	  MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @GeometricallyIrreducible)
115	    (Over.isPullback_left C (overSpec k K)) inferInstance
116

118	
119	The degree stack phrases smoothness and quasi-compactness on `X ↘ Spec K`. Since
120	`(C ⊗ overSpec k K).left ↘ Spec K` is definitionally `(snd C (overSpec k K)).left`
121	(`baseChange_over_eq_snd_left`), these bridge instances are the transported raw instances,
122	now discoverable under the `↘`-key. -/

125	instance instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange :
126	    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 ((C ⊗ overSpec k K).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
127	  inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (snd C (overSpec k K)).left)
128	
129	/-- **Item 4a.** `C_K` is proper over `K`, in the `↘`-spelling. -/
130	instance instIsProperBaseChange :
131	    IsProper ((C ⊗ overSpec k K).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
132	  inferInstanceAs (IsProper (snd C (overSpec k K)).left)
133	
134	/-- **Item 4b.** `C_K` is quasi-compact over `K`, in the `↘`-spelling (properness gives
135	quasi-compactness through `UniversallyClosed`). -/
136	instance instQuasiCompactBaseChange :
137	    QuasiCompact ((C ⊗ overSpec k K).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
138	  inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact (snd C (overSpec k K)).left)
139	
140	/-! ## Item 3: integrality of the base-changed curve
141	
142	Geometric irreducibility (transported above) together with geometric reducedness (free from
143	smoothness, `Smooth.geometricallyReduced`) gives integrality, via the landed
144	`isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced` applied to the bundled base-changed curve. -/
145	
146	/-- **Item 3.** The base-changed curve `C_K` is integral: it is geometrically irreducible and
147	geometrically reduced over `K`. This is the genuine content of gap G-D5(a) — the definition of
148	geometric irreducibility/reducedness of `C/k` gives integrality of `C ⊗_k K` for *every* field
149	extension `K`. The bundled curve `Over.mk (snd …)` reroutes the raw-morphism instances above to
150	the `X.hom` shape that `isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced` reads (geometric reducedness is
151	free from smoothness). -/
152	instance instIsIntegralBaseChange : IsIntegral ((C ⊗ overSpec k K).left) :=
153	  let bundled : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) := Over.mk (snd C (overSpec k K)).left
154	  haveI : GeometricallyIrreducible bundled.hom := instGeometricallyIrreducibleSndLeft C K
155	  haveI : GeometricallyReduced bundled.hom :=
156	    (inferInstance : GeometricallyReduced (snd C (overSpec k K)).left)
157	  isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced bundled
158

160

162	bundled base-changed curve `Over.mk (snd C (overSpec k K)).left` (whose structure morphism is

164	`(C ⊗ overSpec k K).left.moduleKSheaf K` spelling that `classDeg` queries. -/
165	
166	/-- **Item 5a.** `H⁰(C_K, 𝒪)` is a finite `K`-module. -/
167	instance instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange :
168	    Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule ((C ⊗ overSpec k K).left.moduleKSheaf K) 0) :=
169	  let bundled : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) := Over.mk (snd C (overSpec k K)).left
170	  haveI : IsProper bundled.hom := instIsProperSndLeft C K
171	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 bundled.hom := instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionSndLeft C K
172	  haveI : GeometricallyIrreducible bundled.hom := instGeometricallyIrreducibleSndLeft C K
173	  moduleFinite_hModule_zero bundled
174	
175	/-- **Item 5b.** `H¹(C_K, 𝒪)` is a finite `K`-module. -/
176	instance instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange :
177	    Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule ((C ⊗ overSpec k K).left.moduleKSheaf K) 1) :=
178	  let bundled : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) := Over.mk (snd C (overSpec k K)).left
179	  haveI : IsProper bundled.hom := instIsProperSndLeft C K
180	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 bundled.hom := instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionSndLeft C K
181	  haveI : GeometricallyIrreducible bundled.hom := instGeometricallyIrreducibleSndLeft C K
182	  moduleFinite_hModule_one bundled
183

185	
186	The landed degree homomorphism `classDeg K` typechecks on the base-changed curve `C_K` with

193	private noncomputable def classDegBaseChangeSmoke :
194	    Additive ((C ⊗ overSpec k K).left.CechPic) →+ ℤ :=
